content.value_statement: Influencer traffic often drops when the landing page does not match the creator message. This skill turns campaign inputs into a practical page audit, CTA plan, and A/B testing roadmap.
actual_capabilities: Scores message match between creator content and the landing page.
Recommends page structure for influencer-driven traffic.
Plans social proof placement for creators, reviews, and trust signals.
Improves promo-code visibility, CTA copy, and mobile conversion paths.
Builds a prioritized A/B testing roadmap with hypotheses and metrics.
Defines tracking targets for conversion rate, bounce rate, add-to-cart, and AOV.
limitations: It depends on user-supplied data unless analytics or CMS connectors are available.
It does not measure results after launch; use a performance analysis workflow for that.
It does not implement page changes inside a CMS or storefront.
Impact estimates are planning assumptions, not guaranteed conversion lift.

use_cases.title: Fix a low-converting creator page
use_cases.description: Audit the page, identify message gaps, and prioritize changes that can raise conversion rate.

use_cases.title: Prepare a dedicated campaign landing page
use_cases.description: Plan hero copy, creator proof, promo-code handling, and mobile CTA placement before launch.

use_cases.title: Create a landing page test roadmap
use_cases.description: Turn page observations into ranked A/B test hypotheses with metrics, duration, and success criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Basic landing page audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize our landing page for influencer traffic. The page is [URL], the creator is [handle], and the promo code is [code].

prompt_templates.title: Improve a low conversion rate
prompt_templates.prompt: Our creator landing page converts at [rate]. Audit message match, CTA placement, promo-code friction, and mobile issues.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a creator-specific page
prompt_templates.scenario: New landing page for one influencer
prompt_templates.prompt: Design the structure for a dedicated landing page for [creator]. Include hero message, proof hierarchy, promo treatment, FAQ, and tracking events.

prompt_templates.title: Build an A/B testing roadmap
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced conversion planning across multiple hypotheses
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prioritized A/B test roadmap for this influencer campaign. Use [baseline metrics], [traffic estimate], [offer], and [business goal].

output_examples.input: A fitness creator sends traffic to a protein powder page with a 1.2% conversion rate.
output: Priority fixes: match the headline to taste claims, feature the creator video, auto-apply the promo code, and move mobile CTA above the fold.
Test plan: update hero first, then test headline and CTA copy.

output_examples.input: A beauty brand needs a landing page for one creator and a limited-time discount.
output: Recommended structure: creator-led hero, product benefits, creator proof, customer reviews, FAQ, and final CTA.
Promo plan: show the creator code near price, confirm savings, and preserve the code through checkout.
Tracking plan: use creator UTM parameters and monitor conversion rate, add-to-cart, bounce rate, and AOV.

best_practices: Provide the creator message, page URL, promo code, and current conversion rate when available.
Use the recommendations to brief designers, copywriters, and page builders before implementation.
Run the highest-impact test first and define one primary success metric.
anti_patterns: Do not optimize only the headline while ignoring promo-code friction and mobile CTA placement.
Do not treat estimated lift as proven performance without a follow-up measurement step.
Do not reuse a generic product page when creator traffic expects a specific promise or proof point.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill need?
faq.answer: It works best with the landing page URL, creator handle, campaign message, promo code, conversion goal, and current performance data.

faq.question: Can it work without analytics access?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use user-supplied metrics and campaign details when live analytics connectors are not available.

faq.question: Does it change the landing page for me?
faq.answer: No. It produces an audit, recommendations, and test plan for implementation in your CMS or storefront.

faq.question: Does it support paid ad landing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions include a paid traffic variant focused on post-click message match and offer consistency.

faq.question: How does it handle promo codes?
faq.answer: It checks visibility, auto-apply options, savings confirmation, and the path from landing page to checkout.

faq.question: What should I use after applying the recommendations?
faq.answer: Use a performance analysis workflow to measure conversion rate, AOV, attribution, and test results after launch.
